title: Spectral Smoothing and Spiking Perturbations Reconfigure Capability Profiles and Selective Task Performance in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.30676v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Singular-value spectra encode important structure in transformer feed-forward projections, yet their causal role in downstream behavior remains underexplored. We study post-hoc spectral smoothing and spiking interventions on the up_proj and down_proj matrices. Positive perturbation stretches deviations from the geometric mean, making large singular values larger and small ones smaller (spiking), and vice versa. The intervention preserves singular vectors and the geometric mean of the singular values. Across five open Llama and Qwen instruction models, we evaluate the perturbed systems on capability-labeled subtasks, standard and chain-of-thought reasoning benchmarks, judge-scored truthfulness, hallucination, and safety tasks, and TRAIT personality probes. translated_title: 谱平滑与尖峰扰动重构大语言模型的能力画像与选择性任务表现
translated_abstract: 奇异值谱编码了Transformer前馈投影中的重要结构，但其在下游行为中的因果作用仍鲜有探索。我们研究了针对up_proj和down_proj矩阵的事后谱平滑与尖峰干预。正向扰动会拉伸偏离几何均值的程度，使大奇异值更大、小奇异值更小（尖峰化），反之亦然。该干预保留了奇异向量以及奇异值的几何均值。我们在五个开源的Llama和Qwen指令模型上对扰动后的系统进行评估，涵盖能力标注子任务、标准推理与思维链推理基准、由评审打分的真实性、幻觉与安全任务，以及TRAIT人格探测。为了解释分数的变化，我们在由事实知识、语言理解和演绎推理构成的三维能力基中对模型响应进行拟合。所引发的变化……
tldr: 该论文通过对Transformer前馈投影矩阵的奇异值谱进行平滑与尖峰化干预（保持奇异向量和几何均值不变），以三维能力基（事实知识、语言理解、演绎推理）为解释框架，系统揭示并重构了大语言模型的能力画像及其在各类任务上的选择性表现变化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces spectral smoothing and spiking interventions on the singular-value spectra of transformer feed-forward projection matrices—preserving singular vectors and the geometric mean—and interprets the resulting score shifts within a three-dimensional capability basis (factual knowledge, language understanding, deductive reasoning), thereby reconfiguring capability profiles and selectively altering task performance in large language models.
